contract: Sahabat Belajar (SLB B-C Wijayakusumah) Auth Visual Contract. Full-bleed bg.png sunny school background with frosted glass cards, crisp contrast scrim, and bespoke Murid & Guru 16:9 cover illustrations matching bg.png.

accessibility.evidence: Verified color tokens with scripts/check-contrast.mjs passing WCAG AA/AAA. Frosted glass containers (88%-96% opacity white + blur) ensure >= 12:1 contrast against bright bg.png sky/trees; descriptive alt text added on murid-cover.jpg and guru-cover.jpg.

responsive.evidence: Role grid flows from 2 columns (max-width 720px) on desktop to 1 column on mobile (<= 640px). Cover illustrations use 16:9 aspect-ratio without cropping subjects across viewports.

loading.evidence: Static cover assets and CSS gradients render smoothly with soft pastel fallback backgrounds behind images.

empty.evidence: Empty content states in student/admin modules remain polite and actionable.

error.evidence: Auth validation alerts render cleanly inside elevated frosted cards.

partial.reason: Login screens render complete cards atomically.

success.evidence: Student and teacher logins redirect properly verified by PHPUnit AuthTest (8/8 passing).

permission.evidence: Guest and role access rules verified cleanly.
